purpose: A bounded one-seed admission pilot that verifies the full two-loop policy path before any formal GPU or publication comparison.

runtime_boundary.reason: Avoid contention with the active serial MOF A10G campaign.
runtime_boundary.interpretation: CPU timings and results validate execution only; they are not formal GPU performance numbers.

policy_generation.outer_generated: One structured proposal after all eight development evaluation receipts are complete.
policy_generation.removed: One structured proposal with the same action menu and call limit but without development metric feedback.

manual_control.rationale: Pre-registered coordinate-coverage heuristic, selected before toluene evaluation.

holdout_design.score_release: Only after all four training and independent evaluation receipts are closed.

claim_boundary.allowed_claim: The pilot may establish execution feasibility and generate a paired directional observation.

outer_loop: one receipt per outer model call
artifact_contract.failure: Any failed run stops the campaign; no automatic rerun or replacement.
